reviews.title: Repetitive Content and a Ridiculous Cancellation Process
reviews.text:
This app recycles the same handful of storylines in different formats and expects subscribers to pay for the privilege of watching the same tired plots over and over. The lack of originality is bad enough, but the cancellation process is even worse.

The cancellation instructions don’t match the actual options available, making it unnecessarily difficult to cancel a subscription. Conveniently, signing up is easy, but getting out is another story.

If your content isn’t good enough to keep paying customers, don’t resort to making it difficult for them to leave. Repetitive stories, frustrating navigation, and a cancellation process that feels deliberately obstructive. Save your money and your patience. This app simply isn’t worth it.

This creates a situation where users are being charged weekly without a clear way to cancel. I believe this is deceptive and should be investigated immediately. I was still being charged while actively trying to cancel my subscription.
